# Milton Heating & Cooling

> Milton Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Milton, Wellington County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Service areas: Milton, Guelph, Georgetown, Fergus, Elora, Acton, Rockwood
